name: Deputymon
main_effect:
[On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with the [Three Musketeers] trait and 1 Option card with a memory cost of 7 among them to your hand. Trash the remaining cards.
[Your Turn] This Digimon can digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Three Musketeers] trait from your hand for a memory cost of 6, ignoring its digivolution requirements.
